name: FastAT Benchmark
description: Fast Adversarial Training (FastAT) seeks to achieve adversarial robustness at a fraction of the computational cost incurred by standard multi-step methods such as PGD-AT. Although numerous FastAT techniques have been proposed in recent years, fair comparison among them remains elusive. Existing benchmarks and public leaderboards typically permit diverse model architectures, varying training configurations, and external data sources, making it unclear whether reported improvements reflect genuine algorithmic advances or merely more favorable experimental conditions.
